summary.text: Borgu’s Wasangari kingdoms fought with horse-mounted warriors from the 15th century. They held off Songhai raids, broke Oyo’s army in 1783, and sent their horsemen to die with Oyo’s in the last war against Ilorin.

record.text: Borgu regained its full independence by beating Oyo at Gberegburu.
Siru Kpera of Nikki died with Alaafin Oluewu in the war at Ilorin.
